node.label: Coat hanger sign of ribs
node.definition: An abnormal morphology of the ribs consisting of shorted, abnormally curved ribs. On posteroanterior chest radiography, the ribs show a curvature resembling that of a coat hanger (clothes hanger).

evidence.snippet: Kagami-Ogata syndrome due to paternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 14: Coat hanger sign of ribs (frequency HP:0040280) [TAS]
